Prototype-method loads on MlFakeDevice/MlFakeFile instances. The documented recipe was implemented and exhaustively tried: prototype shapes (constructor first, then each method as closure with exact target-function range) and shape_bindings on MlFakeDevice.prototype at the completed method store (558:5:558:27 and alternate all-any/omitted-constructor variants) and at the constructor store receiver (581:5:581:27), plus instance shape + prototype-shape guards on every `this`/device receiver. Dryrun shows zero prototype property loads or prototype-method calls optimized in every configuration (the prototype half of the guard never matches), so the prototype shape was removed to avoid nullifying the own-shape fast path. The corresponding CALL sites are separately optimized with closure type guards on the method member expressions; the property loads themselves remain generic.
